To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the death of Michael Jacks on June 25th, 2009 has had a major impact on the lives of his fans, that fans' reactions to his death were influenced by their personal relationship with him, that their use of interpersonal communication and social media differed depending on whether they based their identity on him or on the fact of being a fan, and that the use of social media was associated with a slower recovery of the fans' sense of well-being.
the death of a celebrity is a key event for understanding the relationship that fans have with their celebrity and that the use of social media in mourning is a key element of this relationship.

the role of social media in mourning processes and with the role played by the celebrity in the construction of a fan's identity.

the death of a celebrity is an opportunity for fans to re-evaluate the role of this celebrity in their lives and to re-evaluate their own identity, especially if their identity was based on the celebrity.
